value.behaviour: Falls back to catalogApi.getEntityByFormerRef on a direct getEntityByRef miss and redirects with replace: true and location.state.redirectedFrom while preserving sub-route path, search, and hash.
rules: 1. Import DEFAULT_NAMESPACE and stringifyEntityRef from '@backstage/catalog-model', useRouteRef alongside errorApiRef, useApi, and useRouteRefParams from '@backstage/core-plugin-api', and useLocation alongside useNavigate from 'react-router-dom'.
2. In useAsyncRetry, first call const entity = await catalogApi.getEntityByRef({ kind, namespace, name }); if defined, return { entity, redirectedFrom: undefined } with zero extra queries.

3. When getEntityByRef returns undefined, call const formerEntity = await catalogApi.getEntityByFormerRef?.({ kind, namespace, name }); if defined, compute requestedRef = stringifyEntityRef({ kind, namespace, name }) and targetRef = stringifyEntityRef(formerEntity), returning { entity: formerEntity, redirectedFrom: targetRef !== requestedRef ? requestedRef : undefined }.

4. In a useEffect, when value?.entity && value?.redirectedFrom is truthy, construct the target path using entityRoute({ kind: value.entity.kind.toLocaleLowerCase('en-US'), namespace: (value.entity.metadata.namespace ?? DEFAULT_NAMESPACE).toLocaleLowerCase('en-US'), name: value.entity.metadata.name }) (preserving any sub-route path suffix after entityRoute({ kind, namespace, name }) in location.pathname, plus location.search and location.hash) and call navigate(targetUrl, { replace: true, state: { ...(typeof location.state === 'object' && location.state !== null ? location.state : {}), redirectedFrom: value.redirectedFrom } }).

sites.rule: Update useEntityFromUrl to fall back to catalogApi.getEntityByFormerRef?.({ kind, namespace, name }) on a direct miss and redirect with replace: true and state: { ...location.state, redirectedFrom }.

2. When redirectedFrom is non-empty and not dismissed, render <Box mb={2}><Alert severity="info" onClose={() => setDismissed(true)} data-testid="entity-renamed-notice">{t('entityPage.renamedNotice', { formerEntityRef: redirectedFrom })}</Alert></Box>.
3. Inside EntityLayout, render {entity && <EntityRenamedNotice />} immediately before {entity && <RoutedTabs routes={routes} />}.

value.behaviour: Falls back to catalogApi.getEntityByFormerRef on a direct getEntityByRef miss in TechDocs and redirects to the renamed entity's TechDocs URL preserving sub-path, query string, and hash.
rules: 1. Accept an optional second parameter options?: { subPath?: string; search?: string; hash?: string } in useExternalRedirect(entityRef: CompoundEntityRef, options?: { subPath?: string; search?: string; hash?: string }).

2. In useAsync, call const catalogEntity = await catalogApi.getEntityByRef(entityRef); if catalogEntity is defined and has TECHDOCS_EXTERNAL_ANNOTATION, return { redirectUrl: buildTechDocsURL(catalogEntity, viewTechdocLink), redirectedFrom: undefined }.

3. If catalogEntity is undefined, call const formerEntity = await catalogApi.getEntityByFormerRef?.(entityRef); if formerEntity is defined and stringifyEntityRef(formerEntity) !== entityKey, build baseUrl = buildTechDocsURL(formerEntity, viewTechdocLink), append options?.subPath (when non-empty, separated by '/'), options?.search, and options?.hash, and return { redirectUrl, redirectedFrom: entityKey }.

4. In useEffect, when externalRedirectResult.value?.redirectUrl is defined: if externalRedirectResult.value.redirectedFrom is defined, call navigate(externalRedirectResult.value.redirectUrl, { replace: true, state: { redirectedFrom: externalRedirectResult.value.redirectedFrom } }); otherwise call navigate(externalRedirectResult.value.redirectUrl, { replace: true }) (preserving exact arguments for external annotation redirects).

sites.rule: Update useExternalRedirect to fall back to catalogApi.getEntityByFormerRef?.(entityRef) when getEntityByRef returns undefined, preserving subPath/search/hash and passing state: { redirectedFrom } on former-name redirects.

value.behaviour: Passes route sub-path, search, and hash to useExternalRedirect and renders a dismissible Alert banner when TechDocsReaderPage was reached via a former-name redirect.

Import useEffect and useState alongside Children, ReactElement, ReactNode, useMemo from 'react', useLocation and useParams alongside useOutlet from 'react-router-dom', Alert from '@material-ui/lab/Alert', useTranslationRef from '@backstage/core-plugin-api/alpha', and techdocsTranslationRef from '../../../translation'.

2. In TechDocsReaderPage, read const { '*': subPath = '' } = useParams(); and const location = useLocation(); and pass { subPath, search: location.search, hash: location.hash } as the second argument to useExternalRedirect(memoizedEntityRef, { subPath, search: location.search, hash: location.hash }).
